units.source_text: [\[8\]](#part1330.html#w8) 位是日本朝廷诸臣爵位高低的标志，

en.t: [8] Rank was the marker of the relative status of officials in the Japanese court,

units.source_text: 从一位到八位（最低位）共三十级，

en.t: from the First Rank down to the Eighth Rank, the lowest, there were thirty grades in all,

units.source_text: 各有正、从之分，四位以下又有上、下之分。

en.t: each divided into Senior and Junior, while ranks of the Fourth and below were further divided into Upper and Lower.

units.source_text: 女御的爵位是三位，更衣是四位。

en.t: A nyogo held the Third Rank, while a koi held the Fourth Rank.

units.source_text: 追赠三位，即追封为女御。

en.t: To posthumously bestow the Third Rank was therefore to posthumously confer the status of nyogo.
